## 0.11.0-beta.5 - 2026-10-06

### Added

- Added Muse Code as a provider, with model, approval mode, and reasoning effort controls ([#5719](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5719), [#5775](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5775) by @millerben95)
- Added Antigravity as a provider that drives the installed `agy` CLI, always in Full access ([#5714](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5714), [#5795](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5795))
- Added a Usage screen, opened from the sidebar footer, showing each subscription account's quota windows with Refresh ([#5465](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5465), [#5685](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5685), [#5786](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5786), [#5805](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5805), [#5921](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5921))
- Added an opt-in Usage summary to the sidebar footer that shows the windows you pin ([#5903](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5903), [#5975](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5975), [#6089](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/6089))
- Added Usage discovery of ChatGPT logins from Codex CLI, OpenCode, Pi, and OMP ([#5844](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5844))
- Added Usage discovery of Claude logins from the Claude Code credential file, the macOS keychain, Pi, and OMP ([#5844](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5844))
- Added OpenCode Go to Usage ([#5465](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5465))
- Added the reason a Usage card is unavailable, such as an expired login with the command that refreshes it, listing each login's error when none works ([#5876](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5876), [#6156](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/6156))
- Added mid-turn steering to OMP agents ([#5550](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5550) by @n24q02m)
- Added Fast mode and an Auto thinking level to OMP ([#5550](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5550) by @n24q02m, @abhi-wan-kenobi)
- Added MCP servers to OMP schedules and Hub runs ([#5550](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5550) by @omercnet)
- Added a Content width setting for the maximum width of chat and Markdown files on wide screens ([#5680](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5680))
- Added `agents.providers.<id>.options` in `config.json` as default options for every provider, with per-agent overrides ([#5780](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5780))
- Added the terminal key bar and Paste to terminal panes on iPad and Android tablets ([#5712](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5712) by @lardissone)
- Added screens and sidebar header and footer items to the plugin SDK ([#5685](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5685))
- Added usage sources to the plugin SDK ([#5465](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5465), [#5876](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5876))
- Added `spawnProcess()`, `execCommand()`, and `terminateProcess()` to the plugin SDK for launching CLIs, including Windows `.cmd` and `.bat` scripts ([#6151](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/6151))
- Added `client.playAudio()` to the plugin SDK for playing audio on every client ([#5976](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5976))
- Added an `agent.closed` plugin lifecycle event ([#5971](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5971) by @ilteoood)
- Added command and environment overrides and availability diagnostics for plugin providers ([#5707](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5707))

### Changed

- Enabled the plugin registry by default: `paseo plugin add owner/slug` installs a reviewed artifact even when a local directory matches; use explicit local paths (including `.`, `..`, and Windows drive or UNC paths), and use `github:owner/repository` for direct GitHub installs. Registry connection, missing-ID, and `--ref` errors include recovery steps.

- Changed the context window details to show usage for the account the agent runs under, including custom `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` and `CODEX_HOME` homes ([#5465](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5465))
- Changed the context window details on desktop to a hover card with Refresh ([#5975](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5975))
- Changed the context window meter to show before an agent's first turn ([#6089](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/6089))
- Changed Codex Fast to a Speed menu listing the Normal, Fast, and Ultrafast speeds each model offers, shown as a lightning bolt on desktop that turns yellow while Fast or Ultrafast is selected ([#5708](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5708), [#6152](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/6152) by @Nurshot)
- Changed Explorer tabs to work like workspace tabs, with a + menu, drag and drop, and Close for Files and Changes ([#5942](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5942))
- Changed Pi and OMP extension context to show as expandable tool rows instead of assistant text, and to hide Pi messages marked hidden ([#6090](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/6090))
- Moved Import session from the sidebar footer to the New workspace screen ([#5805](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5805))
- Changed the sidebar workspace row to show last activity by default on new installs ([#6087](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/6087))
- Changed compact sidebar footer buttons to 44×44 tap targets ([#6044](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/6044))
- Changed new workspaces branched from `origin/main` or another remote branch to fetch that branch first ([#5788](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5788) by @odoo-mvds)
- Changed Paseo's internal Claude agents for branch names, commit messages, and PR text to run with Claude hooks disabled ([#5750](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5750))
- Changed OMP approval mode changes to apply on the next idle relaunch, and to be refused during a turn ([#5550](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5550))
- Changed relative timestamps in agent, schedule, and Import session rows to keep advancing while on screen ([#5340](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5340))

paseo.commit_message:
feat(website): copy states what Paseo does, plugins section and comparison tables (#6270)

The homepage, README, sponsor copy and comparison pages now say plainly
what Paseo is: a one-click desktop app with the daemon bundled, a native
mobile app with full parity, parallel agents in worktrees, and plugins
that add panels and functionality on desktop, web and mobile.

Every comparison page uses one table with the same rows so readers can
compare products row by row. The product columns use a fixed layout so
column widths no longer follow the longest cell.

Sponsor copy opens with the project's size before the one-person fact,
so a reader does not take "one person" to mean a side project.

ruflo.release_body:
## ruflo 3.53.0

The npm packages (`@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow`, `ruflo`) are a version bump plus a catalog entry. The big changes live in the console, ruflo-protector and mods plugins, which reach you through the git marketplace, not npm.

### What is new: ruflo-console 0.34.0

- **Intelligence views**: a memory map (a hash layout, labelled as such, not a similarity map), a learning pipeline and router picture, explain-a-recall with a pattern lifecycle, and memory health.
- **Workflows board**: phases, agents, model, tokens and time per run, with drill-down, search and logs, replay, compare, export, cost and a budget guard, triage, alerts, a worktree manager, templates, and Anatole per agent.
- **Control plane and multi-model bridge**: Stop, Message and Redirect through TaskStop and SendMessage, proven for Agent-tool background agents and **unverified for a workflow run's own agents**. A Conversation pane covers Claude, the hive, federation, Codex, and OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- **Mission autopilot**: one approved scope envelope, a journal, a kill switch, parking, and governed self-tuning that cannot widen its own envelope. **It has not yet run in a live interactive session**, and long runs need the session to stay alive.
- Three adversarial audits were run on the above.

### How to get it

npm: `npx ruflo@latest`. For the console, ruflo-protector and mods:

```
claude plugin marketplace update ruflo
claude plugin update ruflo-console@ruflo
```

then restart Claude Code.

### Known limits

- About 190 ms extra plugin load per start (the engine transpiles the whole module graph). All 216 kit tests pass file by file, but 3 to 8 time out when all 25 files run at once under heavy load.
- npm Audit checks are red on main from newly published advisories in dependencies (proxy-addr, tinypool, and one more transitive). Being fixed separately.
- SendMessage delivery and agent control inside a workflow run are unverified.

orca.release_body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

Remote Server is an experimental feature and may have bugs. Remote Server 2.0 is coming this week and will eliminate most of them.

## The short version

- **Security fix for Copilot:** When Orca marked a folder as trusted for GitHub Copilot, it could leave `~/.copilot/config.json` readable by other users on the same machine. That file can hold your Copilot login tokens. v1.4.219 and v1.4.220 did this on SSH hosts too, where other people often share the machine. The file is now owner-only after Orca writes to it. A file an older Orca already opened up is fixed the next time Orca adds a new folder to it.
- **Codex on Windows uses your own `~/.codex`:** Codex in Orca now uses the same folder as Codex outside Orca, as it already did on macOS and Linux. If you only signed in inside Orca, that sign-in is copied over so you stay logged in. Codex may ask again to trust a folder or approve a command, and MCP servers you added only inside Orca need to be added again; a one-time message explains this. Codex terminals that were open before the update keep working on Orca's old folder, keep their Orca-only MCP servers, and no longer show a restart dialog.
- **Codex workers:** `worker-start` now accepts `max` and `ultra` effort for Codex models Orca doesn't list yet, such as the gpt-6.x models, instead of refusing them.
- **More agents and accounts:** Qoder conversations appear in session history and search, Orca can launch Qoder CLI China and Qwen Code, and GLM Coding Plans can be linked without ZCode. OpenCode and Devin can keep separate account profiles, Antigravity gets an Accounts card, and Antigravity IDE and 2.0 conversations can continue in a new CLI conversation.
- **Native chat (experimental):** Workspaces on a paired Orca server open structured chats when chat is your default. OpenCode sessions can use Chat. A Claude subagent waiting on a permission prompt reads as waiting, and chat errors use plain wording without loading flashes or duplicate reports.
- **Agent status and orchestration:** Codex's "Implement this plan?" menu and open agent questions now count as waiting on you, so sent text no longer lands on the menu. OMP 18.4 workers start, and an agent now uses Orca's own `orca` command even when shell startup files put an older global install first.
- **Files, Markdown and search:** Semicolon-separated CSVs show as columns. Large Markdown previews load faster, Find in them opens faster, and oversized tables are readable. Typing with Find open no longer jumps the caret. Search finds the right files and tells you when it couldn't finish, and file updates recover after SSH reconnects or replaced folders.
- **Workspaces and notifications:** Desktop notifications can be turned off per machine. A worktree delete that git can't finish stays listed so you can retry, and workspaces in WSL-runtime projects on `C:\` can be deleted again. Create PR asks your agent to write the PR details on an already pushed branch, and Jira search accepts plain words.
- **Updates and memory:** On macOS, Update & Restart no longer closes Orca and then waits forever on background Orca servers; Orca tells you what to close and lets you retry. Many fixes let Orca free memory held by closed tabs, previews, phone screens and idle caches.

**Terminals you already had open:** Updating starts a new terminal background service. Terminals open before the update keep running on the previous one. New terminals use the new service and get this release's terminal fixes, including the `orca` command fix above, OpenCode and Devin account profiles, and agent detection and resume for jcode, Qoder CLI China, Qwen Code and Cursor.

## Known issues

**Windows on ARM:** The ARM64 package ships an x64 `orca.exe` command-line tool. Windows 11 on ARM runs it under emulation. Windows 10 on ARM can't run it, so the `orca` command does not work there (#24094).

**OpenCode 2:** If you update from v1.4.219 or earlier, OpenCode 2 panes that were already running may show no status until you restart OpenCode in them. If you downgrade Orca after updating, duplicate OpenCode status plugins are left behind. After `opencode run` exits, its pane can keep showing "Done"; a fix is pending in #24472.

**OpenCode workers:** On a busy machine, an OpenCode worker started with `orca orchestration worker-start`, or an OpenCode tab launched with a prompt, can occasionally leave its task sitting unsent in OpenCode's input box. Pressing Enter in that pane sends it. A fix (#25101) is on main and will ship in a later release.

**Codex:** After you upgrade, Codex launches use Orca's managed Codex home until Codex approves Orca's new status hook. A resumed pane that uses `~/.codex` can pause for up to 30 seconds (#23552).

**Claude folder trust:** Folder pre-trust is on by default (Settings → Agents → "Trust the folder when Orca starts an agent"). On Alpine WSL, Orca can't copy the file permissions it needs, so Claude shows its own trust prompt instead (#23744).

---

## Product experience

### Codex & orchestration

*Codex on Windows now runs on your own `~/.codex` without a restart prompt for terminals you already had open, Codex workers accept max and ultra effort on newer models, and orchestration recognizes Codex's plan menu, open agent questions and OMP 18.4.*

fix(native-chat): sending brings the latest into view and follows the reply (#24514)

* fix(native-chat): sending brings the latest into view, with visible jumps to latest and top

Sending while scrolled up left the reader parked in old history, and the way back was a faint button. A send now resumes following, opening a row to read it stops following until it is closed, and Jump to latest and Jump to top sit above the composer. Refs #23797.

* fix(native-chat): a late or unsent answer no longer moves a reader who scrolled away

An answer's reveal is now held from the click and dropped if the reader acts before the host accepts. In the terminal lane, an answer with no terminal to write to reveals nothing.

* fix(native-chat): an empty answer no longer moves the reader

The terminal lane's reveal now uses the same check the send does, and the send-site guard test ignores comments.

* fix(native-chat): preserve upstream retry and question cancellation

* refactor(native-chat): leave Jump to top out of this change

Jump to top moves to its own PR so this one lands the send reveal and
follow behaviour on their own.

* refactor(native-chat): keep Jump to latest's existing look in this change

The solid, fading Jump to latest button moves to the UI PR (#25702) so this one carries only the scroll behaviour.

* Preserve native chat reader intent across submissions and disclosure layout

Replace open-row lifetime tracking with bounded position preservation, and tie delayed reveals to the originating reader and session. Keep queued drafts and picker actions from navigating the transcript.

Co-authored-by: Kelvin Amoaba <97001695+AmoabaKelvin@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix(native-chat): retain reader takeover until its frame ends

Pending reader takeover could keep an earlier end target once a duplicate 250 ms gate expired. Let the existing pending-frame check keep the reader's actual offset until that frame ends.

Move unchanged interactive reveal and approval projection into their existing modules so both view files meet the line limit.

Co-authored-by: Kelvin Amoaba <97001695+AmoabaKelvin@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix(native-chat): only a scroll gesture stops following; sends reveal at the press

Opening or closing a row used to stop the transcript from following the
newest output. A reader at the live end who expanded a tool run then lost
the stream. Sends that wait on the host (answers, commands, goals, option
changes) only brought the latest into view after the host replied, so the
reader watched nothing happen at the press.

Now following stops only on a reader gesture: an upward wheel or scroll key
when there is content above, a scrollbar press, a touch drag once it has
carried the view off the end, or a press on content while already away from
the end. Opening, closing, layout changes and the app's own scrolls never

GenericAgent Desktop 桌面版 / Desktop

三个平台产物来自同一提交，并在公开发布前统一验证。All three platform artifacts come from one commit and are validated before publication.

- Windows x64：下载 `GenericAgent-Desktop-Windows-Portable.zip`，解压后双击 `GenericAgent.exe`。卸载时运行 `uninstall.bat`，再删除解压目录。

- Linux x86_64：下载并解压 `GenericAgent-Desktop-Linux-Portable.tar.gz`，执行 `chmod +x GenericAgent.AppImage` 后运行它。卸载时运行 `uninstall.sh`，再删除解压目录。
  Linux x86_64: extract `GenericAgent-Desktop-Linux-Portable.tar.gz`, run `chmod +x GenericAgent.AppImage`, then launch it. Run `uninstall.sh` before deleting the extracted directory.

The Windows portable build is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn; verify `SHA256SUMS-windows.txt` before running it.

macOS 应用仅使用 ad-hoc 签名，未使用 Apple Developer ID，也未 notarize。首次打开可能需要右键选择“打开”或在“隐私与安全性”中允许。
The macOS app is ad-hoc signed only. It is neither Developer ID signed nor notarized; first launch may require Open from the context menu or approval in Privacy & Security.

SHA-256 清单与各产物一同发布。SHA-256 manifests are included with the artifacts.

claude_codex_bridge.release_body:
# v8.7.6

Released: 2026-10-06

## English

### Claude and Codex delivery reliability

- Recognize native Claude pasted-content envelopes when binding request anchors, reading lifecycle events and matching stop-hook completion. This repairs missed request recognition investigated in #354 while retaining top-level envelope and anchor checks.
- Recognize an empty Codex composer when its configurable status bar uses an undimmed separator or displays `Context 100% left`. Native placeholder styling, cursor and layout establish empty input without depending on model names.
- Preserve draft protection, busy/menu blocking, FIFO and the existing send-once behavior. Unknown nonempty custom layouts remain blocked; no blind Enter retry or duplicate paste is added.

### Verification and upgrade

- The fixes have native Claude envelope/hook/log evidence and guarded Codex 0.156.1 / 0.159.2 tests, including long pastes, draft/menu transitions and a real remote model response. Controlled local-API tests are distinguished from real model tests in the committed evidence.
- Update CCB and reopen the affected project when outstanding work can safely be interrupted so the updated daemon and provider startup hooks are loaded. No manual project, conversation or configuration migration is required.
- Release and mobile package metadata are synchronized; there is no new mobile interface behavior.

### Known limitations

- The empty-composer status-bar fix addresses a pre-send wait. The already-pasted-but-unsubmitted symptom in #356 has not been reproduced or conclusively attributed to this cause; the issue remains open.
- PR #366 and its experimental SSH remote-workspace feature are not included. Its separate file-synchronization fix remains on an isolated branch pending review and qualification.
- Native tests do not establish complete WSL2/Rocky or arbitrary custom-layout compatibility.

## 中文

### Claude 与 Codex 投递稳定性

- 在请求锚点绑定、生命周期事件读取和 stop-hook 完成匹配中识别 Claude 原生 pasted-content 包装，修复 #354 调查中发现的请求识别遗漏，同时保留顶层包装及锚点校验。
- Codex 自定义状态栏使用非暗色分隔符，或显示 `Context 100% left` 时，现在能够识别空输入框。通过原生占位符样式、光标位置和布局确认空输入，不依赖模型名称。
- 保留草稿保护、忙碌/菜单阻塞、FIFO 和单次发送行为。未知布局的非空草稿仍保守阻塞，不增加盲目回车或重复粘贴。

### 验证与升级

- 修复已具备真实 Claude 包装/hook/日志证据，以及 Codex 0.156.1 / 0.159.2 开启保护后的交互验证，覆盖长文本、草稿/菜单切换和真实远端模型回复。提交的证据记录明确区分本地可控接口测试与真实模型测试。
- 更新 CCB 后，请在待处理工作可以安全中断时重新打开受影响项目，使新版 daemon 和 provider 启动 hooks 生效。无需手动迁移项目、对话或配置。
- 发布及手机端包元数据同步更新；本版本没有新增手机界面行为。

### 已知限制

- 状态栏修复解决的是发送前等待。#356 描述的文字已粘贴但未提交现象尚未复现，也未确定与此同因，issue 继续保持开放。
- 不包含 PR #366 及其实验性 SSH 远程工作区功能。其文件同步修复保留在独立分支，等待审查和验证。
- 原生测试不代表完整 WSL2/Rocky 环境或任意自定义布局均已兼容。

> ## Documentation Index
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.trytrellis.app/llms.txt
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

# v0.6.17

> 2026-09-12

Devin CLI 会话记忆、按需读取 SQLite 页，以及任务/会话绑定修复。

## 功能增强

### Devin CLI 会话适配器

`trellis mem` 通过现有的零依赖解析器读取 Cognition Devin CLI 会话，数据在 `~/.local/share/devin/cli/sessions.db`（WAL SQLite）。这不是 `trellis init --devin`（Desktop/Cascade），也不是 Factory Droid。（#614）

* `list` / `search` / `extract` / `context` / `projects` 支持 `--platform devin`
* OpenCode、ZCode 与 Devin 共用 `packages/core/src/mem/internal/sqlite-adapter.ts` 和 `packages/core/src/mem/platforms.ts`
* Devin 会话树要求 `main_chain_id`；缺少 tip 时返回 `devin-main-chain-missing`（不再回退到 `max(node_id)`）
* 解析前去掉 `CREATE TABLE` 的 `--` 行注释，这样 live `sessions.db` 里的 `parent_node_id` 和 `chat_message` 能被识别

## 问题修复

### SQLite 主文件页懒读

`packages/core/src/mem/internal/sqlite-readonly.ts` 里的零依赖 SQLite 读取器按需加载主文件页，不再把整个数据库读进内存。（#596）

### Pi 无头子代理提示

Pi `trellis_subagent` 把 ask-policy 提示转发到父会话。serving heartbeat 设置 `PI_SUBAGENT_PARENT_SESSION`（不用过期的 `PI_SESSION_ID`），设置 `PI_SUBAGENT_CHILD=1`，并丢掉继承来的 `PI_SESSION_ID`，让子进程自己签发会话 id。（#611）

### 活动任务会话回退

当前会话 id 缺失时，不再回退到项目里仅有的那条会话去解析活动任务。该回退改为显式 opt-in，避免一个会话绑到另一个会话的任务。（#608）

### archive 子任务 unlink 回滚

如果 `task.py archive` 在已经 unlink 部分子任务之后失败，会按清除前的快照把每个子任务的 `parent` 写回去。`children` 里的重复条目只快照一次，避免第二次访问把 `parent: null` 写回去。（#613）

## 升级

```bash theme={null}
npm install -g @mindfoldhq/trellis@latest
trellis update
```

无需 `--migrate`。
